special_apis.special_handling: Type name is identical to the sample/project name, so a bare 'Gyrometer' reference collides with the project's implicit RootNamespace. Needs a using-alias or full qualification.

errors_encountered.error: CS0118: 'Gyrometer' is a namespace but is used like a type (Scenario1/2/3 .xaml.cs)
errors_encountered.root_cause: The WinUI 3 scaffold's project name / <RootNamespace>Gyrometer</RootNamespace> creates an implicit 'Gyrometer' namespace symbol that shadows the WinRT type Windows.Devices.Sensors.Gyrometer. Every bare 'Gyrometer' field/variable declaration resolved to the namespace, not the type.
errors_encountered.fix: Added 'using GyrometerSensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.Gyrometer;' to each scenario file and replaced bare 'Gyrometer' type references with the alias (session-log turns 25-29).

errors_encountered.error: CS0103: The name 'App' does not exist in the current context (MainPage/Scenario1/Scenario2 .xaml.cs), 9 errors
errors_encountered.root_cause: The scaffold generated App/MainWindow in the project RootNamespace ('Gyrometer'), but the migrated SDK sample code files kept the sample's original namespaces ('GyrometerCS' / 'SDKTemplate'). A bare 'App.MainWindow' reference in a differently-namespaced file cannot see the scaffold's App class.
errors_encountered.fix: Fully-qualified the reference as 'global::Gyrometer.App.MainWindow' across the scenario/MainPage files (session-log turn 39).

errors_encountered.error: WMC0909 'Cannot resolve DataType local:Scenario' + WMC1111 x:Bind DataTemplate needs x:DataType
errors_encountered.root_cause: Agent authored a DataTemplate using x:Bind with x:DataType="local:Scenario", but the Scenario type was not reachable under the 'local:' xmlns prefix at compile time.
errors_encountered.fix: Reverted the ItemTemplate to a plain {Binding Title} DataTemplate (session-log turn 24).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Repeated CS0118 'namespace but is used like a type' build failures; alias applied one file at a time so the same error re-surfaced across 2-3 build cycles.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Project/RootNamespace name equals the WinRT sensor type name; skill has no entry for this collision so the agent discovered the alias fix by trial and applied it piecemeal.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: using <X>Sensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.<X>; alias in every affected file.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors' entry for CS0118 telling the agent up-front to alias/fully-qualify (or rename RootNamespace) when the project is named after a WinRT type — apply across ALL files in one pass.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: CS0103 'The name App does not exist' (9 errors) after the type-collision fix, from unqualified App.MainWindow references.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Namespace mismatch between scaffold-generated App/MainWindow (RootNamespace) and migrated sample files (sample's own namespace).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Skill guidance to keep the scaffold's App/MainWindow namespace consistent with the migrated code (set RootNamespace to the sample's namespace, or fully-qualify App references) — currently the skill's many 'App.MainWindow' examples silently assume same-namespace scope.
